scripts.contracts:deploy: pnpm --filter @pwnpot/contracts exec hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/Pwnpot.ts --network baseSepolia --parameters ignition/parameters/demo.json --build-profile production --verify
scripts.contracts:verify: pnpm --filter @pwnpot/contracts exec hardhat ignition verify chain-84532
scripts.abi: pnpm contracts:build && node contracts/scripts/export-abi.ts && prettier --write lib/onchain/ctf-platform-abi.ts lib/onchain/level-artifacts.ts
scripts.chain:deploy: pnpm --filter @pwnpot/contracts exec hardhat run scripts/dev-deploy.ts --network localhost
scripts.chain:time: pnpm --filter @pwnpot/contracts exec hardhat run scripts/dev-time.ts --network localhost
scripts.chain:solve: pnpm --filter @pwnpot/contracts exec hardhat run scripts/dev-solve.ts --network localhost
